# Calculate the percentage of total increase caused by Chrome

# From the color detection:
# Chrome (orange) bboxes: [x1, y1, x2, y2]
# Bottom of all bars: y = 853

# First bar (2022-10-01):
chrome_oct_y1 = 747
total_oct_y1 = 642  # top of purple (Edge) section
total_oct_bugs = 190

# Last bar (2023-03-01):
chrome_mar_y1 = 592
total_mar_y1 = 301  # top of purple (Edge) section
total_mar_bugs = 497

# Bottom of chart (y-axis 0)
y_bottom = 853

# Calculate pixel heights
chrome_oct_pixels = y_bottom - chrome_oct_y1
chrome_mar_pixels = y_bottom - chrome_mar_y1
total_oct_pixels = y_bottom - total_oct_y1
total_mar_pixels = y_bottom - total_mar_y1

print(f"Chrome Oct pixels: {chrome_oct_pixels}")
print(f"Chrome Mar pixels: {chrome_mar_pixels}")
print(f"Total Oct pixels: {total_oct_pixels}")
print(f"Total Mar pixels: {total_mar_pixels}")

# Calculate scale (pixels per bug) - should be consistent
scale_oct = total_oct_pixels / total_oct_bugs
scale_mar = total_mar_pixels / total_mar_bugs
scale_avg = (scale_oct + scale_mar) / 2

print(f"\nScale Oct: {scale_oct:.4f} pixels/bug")
print(f"Scale Mar: {scale_mar:.4f} pixels/bug")
print(f"Average scale: {scale_avg:.4f} pixels/bug")

# Calculate Chrome bug counts
chrome_oct_bugs = chrome_oct_pixels / scale_avg
chrome_mar_bugs = chrome_mar_pixels / scale_avg

print(f"\nChrome Oct bugs: {chrome_oct_bugs:.2f}")
print(f"Chrome Mar bugs: {chrome_mar_bugs:.2f}")

# Calculate increases
total_increase = total_mar_bugs - total_oct_bugs
chrome_increase = chrome_mar_bugs - chrome_oct_bugs

print(f"\nTotal increase: {total_increase} bugs")
print(f"Chrome increase: {chrome_increase:.2f} bugs")

# Calculate percentage
percentage = (chrome_increase / total_increase) * 100
print(f"\nPercentage of total increase from Chrome: {percentage:.2f}%")
